author: Mark Atwood
text:
Fixed, and the two named deps were four.

pkix-ct: pkix-path, x509-cert and spki all became optional and gated on log-list. Only pkix-path was reported; cargo reports unused deps one at a time, so fixing it surfaced x509-cert, and fixing that surfaced spki. All three are used only in verify.rs and log_list.rs, both #[cfg(feature = "log-list")]. x509-cert and spki appear in ungated files only inside doc comments, which is not a use. std also needed x509-cert?/std rather than x509-cert/std.

pkix-revocation-http: pkix-revocation AND pkix-path became optional. pkix-revocation is gated on crl, ocsp and async; pkix-path on the same three. The bead said 'looks like the same shape; confirm before changing it' -- confirmed, and it was worth doing: a default build of this crate is not empty, it exposes the URL extractors, the RevocationFetcher trait and the error types, none of which touch either dependency.

The feature powerset caught what grep missed: async_fetcher.rs uses pkix_revocation::Result in real code, not only in doc comments, so 'async' needs dep:pkix-revocation and not just dep:pkix-path. --no-default-features --features async failed until that was added.

Cost: 15 intra-doc links in pkix-revocation-http/src/lib.rs became code spans, because lib.rs is ungated and cannot link to a crate that may not be linked in. Same tradeoff as PKIX-10ev.

cargo build --workspace now reports zero unused dependencies. pkix-revocation-http 0.3.2; pkix-ct was already at an unreleased 0.4.0.
